title: trellis.yaml
description: One service's telemetry declaration. trellis checks the service against the telemetry standard from it and renders its dashboard and alert rules.

service.description: The service name: the repository's name, also its OTEL_SERVICE_NAME and Prometheus job.

title.description: How people write the name, such as WorldView. Defaults to the service name.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace the service runs in.

container.description: The container name when it is not the service name.

host.description: The site's host, such as app.example.com.

routes.description: Route patterns the service must report request durations for.

page.description: True when the service has a page that runs the Faro SDK as <service>-web.

edge.description: What sits in front of the service.

public.description: True when the site is on the internet and reports views to /api/view.

max_label_values.description: How many values one label may take before the cardinality clause fails.
